text:
```yaml
name: Repomix

on:
  workflow_dispatch: {}
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  repomix:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Pack repository with Repomix
        uses: repomix/repomix-action@main
        with:
          compression: true

      - name: Upload Repomix output
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v3
        with:
          name: repomix-output
          path: repomix-output.zip
```
